description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - buy filter: in a supermarket, declare a shopping list, a per-item budget cap and a ban keyword first, then photograph product labels; only a product that is in the list AND within budget AND free of the ban keyword lights up with a banner and one TTS call, while every other product only increments a silent filtered count. No product database, no live price check: name, price and ingredients all come from the host LLM reading the photo, so a misread means a wrong judgement. All shopping data lives in session memory only and is wiped when the summary is confirmed or the agent closes.
name: buy-filter
